readerCopy.body: A surprise can feel like proof that an old problem is returning even when the present disruption has not produced the same consequence. When Uranus squares Chiron, change and sensitivity create friction, making a cancellation, technical failure, departure, or sudden shift hit the part already trained to expect embarrassment, exclusion, or loss of control. The reaction can point to a support that still matters. Rebuilding only what the current situation actually needs prevents an old wound from designing the entire response.
